mapper.select: SELECT rf.FORECAST_ID, rf.FORECAST_NO, rf.FORECAST_NAME, rf.MODEL_ID, bm.MODEL_NAME, rf.FORECAST_TYPE, rf.START_PERIOD, rf.END_PERIOD, rf.VERSION, rf.BASE_TYPE, rf.FORECAST_DESC, rf.STATUS, rf.SUBMIT_USER, rf.SUBMIT_TIME, rf.APPROVE_USER, rf.APPROVE_TIME, rf.APPROVE_OPINION, rf.ORG_ID, rf.CREATE_USER, rf.CREATE_TIME, rf.UPDATE_USER, rf.UPDATE_TIME, rfd.DATA_ID, rfd.FORECAST_ID AS DATA_FORECAST_ID, rfd.PERIOD, rfd.SUBJECT_CODE, rfd.SUBJECT_NAME, rfd.ORGANIZATION_CODE, rfd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rfd.DIMENSION1_CODE, rfd.DIMENSION1_NAME, rfd.DIMENSION2_CODE, rfd.DIMENSION2_NAME, rfd.FORECAST_VALUE, rfd.BASE_VALUE, rfd.ACTUAL_VALUE, rfd.VARIANCE_VALUE, rfd.VARIANCE_RATE, rfd.REMARK FROM TBL_ROLLING_FORECAST rf LEFT JOIN TBL_BUDGET_MODEL bm ON rf.MODEL_ID = bm.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_ROLLING_FORECAST_DATA rfd ON rf.FORECAST_ID = rfd.FORECAST_ID WHERE rf.FORECAST_ID = #{forecastId} ORDER BY rfd.PERIOD, rfd.SUBJECT_CODE, rfd.ORGANIZATION_CODE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "draftCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "submittedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "approvedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "rejectedCount" FROM TBL_ROLLING_FORECAST WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId}

SELECT 'RF' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(FORECAST_NO, 11))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TBL_ROLLING_FORECAST WHERE SUBSTR(FORECAST_NO, 1, 10) = 'RF' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
